==About==

A {{i|Hardboiled Egg}} is made by boiling an {{i|Argopelter Egg}}, {{i|Goose Egg}}, {{i|Eagle Egg}}, {{i|Sparrow Eggs}}, or {{i|Turkey Egg}} in a {{i|Clay Pot}}, {{i|Copper Pot}}, or {{i|Cauldron}}.

==Any Poultry Egg As a Variable Ingredient==
When used as a variable ingredient in recipes {{i|Any Poultry Egg}} gives a Restore [[:Category:Variable Food#Bonus Values|Bonus]].
